significance: A Shiva temple complex near Khunti, about 45 km from Ranchi, established in 1985 on a site formerly called Angrabari and renamed Amreshwar Dham by Shankaracharya Swami Swarupananda Saraswati. It also holds shrines to Ganesha, Rama, Sita and Hanuman, and fills with pilgrims through Sawan and on Maha Shivaratri.
